authority.oda: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 sections 20.1 and 20.4.51: R2007 object RL marks the pre-handle boundary; BLOCK_CONTROL carries null owner, optional extension dictionary, user-block soft owners, and model/paper hard owners.
authority.libredwg: LibreDWG 0.14 src/dwg.spec BLOCK_CONTROL uses CONTROL_HANDLE_STREAM, user entry vector and separate model/paper handles; the independently built decoder was used on physical files below.

problem: The deferred AC1021 BLOCK_CONTROL writer put handles inline in the body. dwgWriter21::finishObject instead treated its separate handle buffer as the handle stream, so the RL was patched to the end of all handle bytes; LibreDWG saw no model/paper references. The local reader incorrectly consumed handles immediately after the body string bit rather than seeking to the RL boundary, masking this loss for locally generated files.
change: Stage AC1021 BLOCK_CONTROL handles for the existing version-specific frame assembler. For AC1021 BLOCK_CONTROL only, parse the handle stream at the RL bit position, validate the absent-string footer and ensure no more than seven trailing padding bits. Preserve older local malformed inline frames only when the exact observed historical signature is met: full-frame RL, fixed control handle, zero reactors and EED, extension-present flag with typed null owner/xdictionary, absent string flag, absolute soft-owner child handles, fixed absolute model/paper hard-owner handles and zero padding. Inconsistent/truncated signatures fail without publication; reuse after failure is tested. Other AC1021 control record profiles and other versions retain their existing routing.

oda_authored_control.producer: ODA File Converter 27.1.0, ACAD2007 DWG, locally generated; no .err output
oda_authored_control.independent: LibreDWG decodes BLOCK_CONTROL size 14 bytes, RL 66 bits, owner 4.0, no xdictionary handle, model 3.1.0x01, paper 3.1.0x02.
oda_authored_control.local: libdxfrw reads the source and publishes BLOCK_CONTROL slot order [0x01,0x02] and three ELLIPSE callbacks.

controlled_writer_comparison.method: Two scratch static-library variants were compiled from identical writer15 source at 7549be9b25c23e378afeccd6087445f3141664fd and identical other library objects; the only source difference is whether AC1021 BLOCK_CONTROL stages its handles. Both wrote one scratch LINE via the same dwgWriter21 producer.
controlled_writer_comparison.independent: Before: LibreDWG reports RL 120 bits, empty handle stream and zero model/paper. After: RL 72 bits, owner 4.0, null extension 3.0, model 3.1.0x17, paper 3.1.0x18. Both complete source files contain the following LINE.
controlled_writer_comparison.local: With the updated reader, both exact old and corrected scratch files publish control slots [0x17,0x18] and the following LINE.
controlled_writer_comparison.oda: ODA File Converter 27.1.0 ACAD2013 DXF reports Invalid input for both files, creates .err for each and no DXF. Exit status alone is not evidence of acceptance.

writer_one_user_control.result: One locally authored AC1021 output has RL 80 bits; LibreDWG decodes ordered user-block handle 2.1.0x30, model 3.1.0x17 and paper 3.1.0x18. The local reader publishes [0x30,0x17,0x18] and the following LINE. This scratch build included unrelated in-progress source edits; no whole-file ODA claim is made.

focused_tests.result: All pass. The boundary selector previously failed when AC1021 was first added before the writer fix. Controls cover AC1015/1018/1021/1024/1027/1032 frames and CRC, an AC1021 user-block child role, exact native/legacy slots, invalid offsets, invalid string footer, truncated legacy handle, nonzero legacy padding, changed legacy role, reset and same-parser retry; the GROUP suite exercises writer rollback/retry and a following entity.

limits: One ODA-authored producer and one independent executable do not qualify general AC1021 writing. The ODA source has a 66-bit unaligned boundary; the current writer has a 72-bit boundary with intervening zero bits. LibreDWG accepts it but ODA whole-file acceptance and the general R2007 alignment/framing policy remain open. Other AC1021 table controls still require separate investigation. No DWG/DXF fixtures were committed.
